parameters.content:
StartCollaborativeBuild
  ├─ Generate sessionId
  ├─ Save to DB
  └─ Execute: SpawnWorkers (pass taskDivision too)
      ↓
SpawnWorkers
  ├─ Spawn workers (workerCount: 3)
  ├─ Append to spawnedWorkers array
  └─ Execute: WaitAndRegister (pass taskDivision)
      ↓
WaitAndRegister
  ├─ Wait for workers ready
  ├─ Register workers
  └─ Execute: CoordinateBuild (pass taskDivision)
      ↓
CoordinateBuild
  ├─ Create session
  ├─ Get position
  ├─ Reserve location
  ├─ Teleport workers
  └─ Execute: DistributeTasks (pass taskDivision) ← HERE!
      ↓
DistributeTasks
  ├─ Function: Convert taskDivision to array
  ├─ Loop through tasks
  ├─ HTTP POST send-task to each worker
  └─ Complete

Pippo_W1.objective: Build complete wall structure from foundation to details
Pippo_W1.assumptions: Flat terrain at spawn location, adequate inventory space
Pippo_W1.constraints: Remain within specified coordinates, do not exceed wall boundaries

constraints: Do NOT place blocks beyond x:105 or before x:95
Do NOT place blocks at z coordinates other than -1
Do NOT modify terrain outside wall footprint
Pippo_W1.fullPrompt:
You are Pippo_W1, building a wall at coordinates X: 95-105, Z: -1, starting at Y: -60.

You are already positioned at your build area. Begin building immediately.

STAGE 1 of 3: Foundation

Task: Build the foundation base of your wall using cobblestone blocks.

Coordinates: X: 95-105, Z: -1, Y: -60

Placement Pattern:
Place cobblestone blocks in a single line from X:95 to X:105 at Z:-1, Y:-60. This creates a 10-block long foundation base, 1 block thick, 1 block high.

Material: cobblestone (11 blocks needed: positions 95, 96, 97, 98, 99, 100, 101, 102, 103, 104, 105)

Constraints:
- Do NOT place blocks beyond X:105 or before X:95
- Do NOT place blocks at Z coordinates other than -1
- Do NOT modify terrain outside wall footprint

You are the sole worker. Begin immediately on your task.

constraints: Do NOT place blocks beyond x:105 or before x:95
Do NOT place blocks at z coordinates other than -1
Do NOT break foundation blocks at Y:-60
Pippo_W1.fullPrompt:
You are Pippo_W1, continuing wall construction at coordinates X: 95-105, Z: -1.

You are already positioned at your build area. Begin building immediately.

STAGE 2 of 3: Wall Structure

Task: Build the main wall body rising from foundation using oak_planks blocks.

Coordinates: X: 95-105, Z: -1, Y: -59 to Y: -56

Placement Pattern:
Build wall rising 4 blocks high (Y: -59, -58, -57, -56) along the entire 10-block length (X: 95-105) at Z: -1. Create a solid wall face by placing oak_planks at each position and height.

Material: oak_planks (40 blocks total: 10 X-positions × 4 Y-levels)

Detailed Placement:
- At X: 95-105, place oak_planks at each Y level: -59, -58, -57, -56
- Each X position gets 4 blocks stacked vertically
- All blocks at Z: -1 (single thickness)

Constraints:
- Do NOT place blocks beyond X:105 or before X:95
- Do NOT place blocks at Z coordinates other than -1
- Do NOT break foundation blocks at Y:-60

You are the sole worker. Begin immediately on your task.

constraints: Do NOT place blocks beyond x:105 or before x:95
Do NOT place blocks at z coordinates other than -1
Do NOT modify wall structure below Y:-56
Pippo_W1.fullPrompt:
You are Pippo_W1, completing wall construction at coordinates X: 95-105, Z: -1.

You are already positioned at your build area. Begin building immediately.

STAGE 3 of 3: Wall Details

Task: Add finishing details and coping to the top of your wall using oak_stairs and oak_slab blocks.

Coordinates: X: 95-105, Z: -1, Y: -56 to Y: -55

Placement Pattern:
Place oak_stairs facing outward (north-facing) along the top of the wall at Y: -56, then cap with oak_slab at Y: -55 for a finished crown detail.

Material: oak_stairs (10 blocks, facing NORTH) + oak_slab (10 blocks, facing NORTH)

Detailed Placement:
- At each X position 95-105, place oak_stairs at Y: -56, facing NORTH
- At each X position 95-105, place oak_slab at Y: -55, facing NORTH (matching stair direction for alignment)
- All blocks at Z: -1

Constraints:
- Do NOT place blocks beyond X:105 or before X:95
- Do NOT place blocks at Z coordinates other than -1
- Do NOT modify wall structure below Y:-56

You are the sole worker. Begin immediately on your task. Wall construction complete after this stage.
